task_description: 128x128x128 bf16 matmul inside a Pallas TPU kernel, comparing jnp.dot (MXU) against an equivalent broadcast-multiply-and-sum (VPU only).

metrics.name: achieved_tflops_pct_of_peak_bf16
metrics.description: achieved TFLOPS as a percentage of v5e's peak bf16 TFLOPS (197.0, see external/accelerator-agents/JAXBench/harness/tpu_specs.py). Computed the same way JAXBench's own utilization_pct is: measured_tflops / peak_tflops_bf16 * 100.
metrics.expected_naive: near 0% -- the whole computation runs on the VPU, never touches the MXU
metrics.expected_optimized: meaningfully higher than naive at this problem size; won't be near 100% because 128x128x128 is a single small block, not enough work to fully saturate the pipeline -- the point of this cell is the naive-vs-optimized delta, not peak utilization
